method.what_this_is: A daily, source-linked briefing of two kinds of public health-tech signals: FDA clearances of AI-enabled medical devices, and private fundraising by health companies. Built for one reader (a non-technical founder tracking US health tech). Every item links to an official record. Nothing here is investment advice.

sections.rules: FDA 510(k) clearances from openFDA, plus new entries on FDA's AI-enabled device list. confidence=confirmed means the device is on FDA's AI list. named means the device or company name says AI. inferred means FDA's own data puts it in a product code where 25%+ of clearances since 2016 are AI, so AI use is a guess to verify at the record.
sections.money: SEC Form D filings in health industry groups with at least $2M sold. Pooled investment funds and amendments are excluded. Some are debt, not equity (equity=false).

known_gaps: Many digital health startups file Form D under Other Technology, so they are missed.
FDA's AI device list updates only every few months, so recent AI devices usually appear as inferred.
No news, stock prices or hiring data yet. Only the two official feeds above.
Why-it-matters lines are not written yet, so the why field is empty.
